(Form Ds 2016-2018 in Menlo Park, Schilling director; merged). e.ventures led Voicea's $14.5M Series A; the CMS dates the firm's entry 'Early 2016', before it: the entry round goes to the stage pass. The $20M minus $14.5M matches the Dec 2016 Rizio Form D ($5.59M sold), whose only related person is CEO Omar Tawakol; Schilling first appears as director on the Dec 2017 Form D. So the CMS 'Early 2016' is unconfirmed: no page ties e.ventures to the 2016 round.
